answer: Divergent Quill-Path Trust. Agents establish `quill`-verified, *disjoint* network paths to ephemeral `sparrow` relays. Paths are distinct if their underlying network `terrace` (routing topology/IP subnets) is diverse. Influence scales with confirmed divergent paths. To simulate `N` Sybils, an attacker must control `N` *geographically/network-topologically distinct* ingress points, each forming its own divergent path set. This forces acquiring substantial, dispersed network infrastructure for every Sybil, linearly escalating costs with `N`.
